LuaActorImpl's BCA at 0x0115FB50 has 3 BCDs: self (TD 0x01270B10) at offset 0; LuaActorImplInterface (TD 0x01270A90 via BCD 0x0115F9D0) at offset 0; LuaAppBase (TD 0x0126CFAC BCS-Y-1582 via BCD 0x011447C0) at offset +4. This CORRECTS the pre-compaction summary that claimed they were siblings.

**The 'xref-on-TD-found-zero-implementor-BCAs' result was a methodology artifact**: BCAs reference BCDs (not TDs directly), so an xref scan for TD 0x01270A90 would only find BCD 0x0115F9D0 itself, NOT the LuaActorImpl BCA at 0x0115FB54 (which points to BCD 0x0115F9D0, not TD 0x01270A90). The inheritance link IS present in the RTTI structures but was missed by the scan methodology.

**The 4 mid-range vftables between LuaActorImplInterface and LuaActorImpl are NOT MI sub-vftables of LuaActorImpl**. They are 4 standalone receiver classes in `Application::Lua::Script::Client::Command::System::*`: ExecutePushOnEnterTriggerBoxReceiver (0x00FDFAF8, TD 0x012c3350), ExecutePushOnLeaveTriggerBoxReceiver (0x00FDFB00, TD 0x012c33B0), AttributeTypeEventEnterReceiver (0x00FDFB0C, TD 0x012c3410), AttributeTypeEventLeaveReceiver (0x00FDFB18, TD 0x012c3470). Each is a 2-slot vftable. ALL ALREADY CATALOGED at BCS-Y-0164/0165/0253/0255/0257/0941.

**All 4 receiver classes share inheritance**: CommandInterface (TD 0x012c3308) at offset 0 + LuaAppBase (TD 0x0126CFAC) at offset +4. So the 4 receivers are concrete Command::System implementations that inherit from the abstract CommandInterface (which was identified earlier as one of the 4 standalone classes at 0x00FDF968..0x00FDF98C).

**LuaActorImpl has 90 slots, LuaActorImplInterface has 90 slots - these are POSITION-MATCHED, NOT independent**. Per the inheritance relationship, LuaActorImpl's 90 concrete vftable slots OVERRIDE the corresponding 90 __purecall slots in LuaActorImplInterface. The previous interpretation (siblings with independent slot semantics) was wrong - they share the same virtual contract with LuaActorImpl as the concrete implementor.
